critical_code_review_comments: CategoryTechExplainer.jsx is ~470 lines and renders 6 large inline SVGs. As more categories or animation variants are added, consider extracting each Schematic{Type}() into /components/schematics/*.jsx so the main file stays focused on layout + i18n binding.

categoryTech.js holds 4-language strings inline alongside the schematic config. Currently OK at ~250 lines, but should be split to /config/i18n/categoryTech.{de,en,ru,uk}.json once the catalogue grows past 8 categories, mirroring the I18nContext concern from iteration 3.

Broken image URL slipped past seed because it returns HTTP 200 (zero-byte). Recommend adding a backend seed-time guard that HEAD-checks each product image and logs a WARN if content-length is 0 or status is not 200. Cheap, prevents silent regressions on user-provided assets.

Five new ECO Warmwasser products are seeded with `created_at` timestamps in 2026 (June) — fine for sort order, but make sure seed_products() is idempotent and won't keep re-stamping created_at on restart (verified: it skips if slug exists, so OK).

rca of the issue: Broken image RCA: The S3-style asset at customer-assets.emergentagent.com/.../jqbgbiqx_inbound5008988608539284716.jpg responds 200 OK but with Content-Length: 0 — the upload pipeline saved a zero-byte file. Browser sets img.naturalWidth=0 → ProductCard shows alt text. Reproduction: curl -sI <url> | grep -i content-length → '0'. Mitigation: re-upload the multiroom panel image and update SEED_PRODUCTS entry for slug 'smart-panel-ceiling-speakers-set' in /app/backend/server.py (or add a startup HEAD-check that warns on 0-byte / 404 images).
